desc: Select two-layer Dijkstra as the primary approach.
Implement the Python program with input parsing, adjacency lists, Dijkstra over 2*N states, and correct answer output.
Run the program on all provided samples and basic edge cases (X=1, large X, multiple reversals) to confirm correctness.
If any sample or performance issue appears, switch to an optimized/fallback approach (e.g., bidirectional Dijkstra or A*) rather than patching the same failing logic.
